## Analysis

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)

# Read CDC mortality dataset
mortality <- read_csv("data/cdc_mortality_trends_2015_2023.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

cvd_causes <- c(
  "Ischemic heart disease",
  "Heart failure",
  "Hypertensive diseases",
  "Cerebrovascular diseases"
)

national_cvd <- mortality |>
  filter(
    jurisdiction == "United States",
    cause_subgroup %in% cvd_causes
  )
```

### Cardiovascular Deaths Over Time (2015–2023)

```{r}
# Line graph showing national trends over the past decade
ggplot(national_cvd, aes(x = year, y = deaths, color = cause_subgroup)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2015:2023) +
  labs(
    title = "U.S. Cardiovascular Deaths (2015–2023)",
    subtitle = "Annual national trends from CDC Provisional Mortality Statistics",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Total Deaths",
    color = "Condition"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Comparing Conditions in 2023

```{r}
# Bar chart comparing deaths across conditions in the most recent year
national_cvd |>
  filter(year == 2023) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(cause_subgroup, deaths), y = deaths, fill = cause_subgroup)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(
    title = "Cardiovascular Deaths by Condition in 2023",
    subtitle = "Ischemic heart disease remains the primary cause of cardiovascular mortality",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Total Deaths"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Growth Trajectories by Condition

```{r}
# Faceted area plot showing individual trajectories and scale
national_cvd |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = deaths, fill = cause_subgroup)) +
  geom_area(alpha = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~cause_subgroup, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2015, 2017, 2019, 2021, 2023)) +
  labs(
    title = "Trajectories by Cardiovascular Condition (2015–2023)",
    subtitle = "Faceted view highlighting differences in scale and growth rate",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Annual Deaths"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
